title: Hearty Spanish Pork Jamon Iberico Cataplana
description: A malty, crunchy, Spanish dish featuring tamarind paste and Jamon Iberico, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cataplana, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the pimenton, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tamarind paste and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and chopped parsley, and stir to combine.
Add the sliced Jamon Iberico and cook for 2 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the cataplana to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until the Jamon Iberico is cooked through.
Remove the cataplana from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the Hearty Spanish Pork Jamon Iberico Cataplana hot, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
